payload.title: FUN-sessions: public-process proof for Factory Sessions after LWR + adapters + CUTs
currentProgress: Factory Sessions LWR-SES, HTTP-SES/CLI-SES/MCP-SES adapters, CUT-SES-RUN, CUT-SES-WRK (#1555), and CUT-SES-WORK (#1546 / c9f3771b2) are Factory-terminal.
Live pkg/services/factory_sessions root directories are already only wire/, internal/, and transports/ plus root contract/test files; no transitional service/ sibling remains to fold/delete.
CUT-SES-WORK removed Work-owned consumer edges from Sessions; Sessions peers must reach Work through the Work service root only.
FUN-sessions closes the Sessions vertical with explicit public-process proof through root.BuildProcess after adapters and consumer cuts.
This packet must stay lease-disjoint from live Work residual cleanup, Runtime folds, provider adapters, Settings/Workers/Recordings/PSES CLN/DEL chains, and PSS-I0* integrators.
payload.requestedOutcome: Prove Factory Sessions as a packaged service through public process composition only: root.BuildProcess, public Sessions protocol surfaces (CLI/HTTP/MCP adapters already terminal), and edges.Edges effect replacement. Extend or add focused functional proofs under tests/functional/sessions (and owner-local root contract tests if needed) so session lifecycle/runtime-opening/work-admission/response-stream surfaces remain inert until runtime lifecycle starts, then exercise public Sessions behavior without importing factory_sessions/internal or factory_sessions/wire implementation details from outside the owner. Confirm no production peer reaches Sessions through transitional packages, and Sessions no longer reaches Work through retired consumer edges (Work root only). Do not fold or delete packages. Do not invent additional Sessions protocol adapters or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Do not open PSS-I0* shared integrators. Do not reopen CUT-SES-* consumer edges beyond proof that they remain closed. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.

exclude Work residual CLN/DEL leases under pkg/services/work/**
